offline_trace_key_findings.timing_limit: These host/RPC timings are against immediate synthesized zero-timestamp responses with capped fake read waits; they cannot be interpreted as real K-line P3 timing.

limitations: Historical physical logs are application-level observations, not full vehicle-bus traces.
No historical physical full81/83 response bytes or bus timings were recovered in the searched paths.
A successful historical DUAL1.07 read does not prove current-RK02 acceptance or exact current ROM content.
July26 failure followed by success supplies no logged intervening physical condition, so no connector or voltage cause can be inferred.
The installed-host fake81 and83 replies were minimal one-byte positive-SID hypotheses and do not reproduce the fuller stock/current vehicle replies.
Matching ECUFlash/OpenPort version banners across dates do not prove historical binary hashes.
The raw fake capture records actual installed-host calls but synthetic response values, no physical provider operation, no ECU kernel execution, and no native timing simulation.
